_meta.description: Where the data comes from and where it must come from before any figure here is treated as fact. Split into primary sources (free, authoritative, automatable), industry sources (the sector-specific reads), and the verification queue — every claim in the dashboard currently entered from memory.
_meta.honesty_note: This is a v1 research build. No figure in this repository has yet been pulled from a primary source by machine. Everything tagged verify:true across the data files is in the queue below.

primary.n: US Census Bureau — population estimates & projections
primary.use: The cohort clock itself. Age-band populations and projections are the master time axis.
Labour force participation by age band. The single highest-value indicator in the thesis.
Job openings and quits in healthcare and construction.
Services versus goods wage growth, composition-controlled. The cleanest read on limb C's inflation claim.
Consumption basket by category. Must be normalised per capita by age band to be informative.

primary.n: Federal Reserve — Financial Accounts & Distributional Financial Accounts
primary.use: Household balance sheets by age and wealth percentile. The source for the wealth-concentration claim and for limb A's flow test.

primary.n: Federal Reserve — Survey of Consumer Finances
primary.use: The authoritative cut of wealth by age. Underpins the top-decile versus median-retiree split.
Trust fund depletion date, worker-to-beneficiary ratio. The forcing function for limb E.
Mandatory spending trajectory and debt path. The fiscal context for the term-premium argument.

primary.n: CMS — rate notices, fee schedules & utilisation files
primary.use: Medicare Advantage benchmarks, physician fee schedule, SNF and home health payment rules, and per-capita utilisation.

primary.n: NY Fed — ACM term premium estimates
primary.use: The arbiter between limb A's duration demand and limb E's issuance pressure.
Trade pipeline completions against retirements. Tests the capacity-gap mechanism.

primary.n: DHS / Census components of change — immigration

industry.use: Senior housing occupancy, rate growth and construction starts. The direct read on limb H.
US annuity sales by product type. The cleanest confirmation or refutation of limb A's behavioural shift.
Advisor channel share, advisor age, rollover volumes. The honest adjudicator for limb B.
Enrolment, completions and qualified applications turned away. The direct test of the capacity gap.
Weekly and monthly flows by vehicle. Limb A's falsifier test.
Private marks for the listed aggregator comps.
Existing-home turnover in retirement metros. Must be read metro by metro; the national number averages the signal away.
Go-go band discretionary demand. Tests the fade timing.

verification_queue.claim: US age-band population projections in data/clock.json
verification_queue.needed: Current Census vintage, by single year of age
verification_queue.affects: The entire cohort clock — the master time axis every panel indexes to. The shape of the curve is robust; the levels are not sourced.

verification_queue.claim: $80-100T wealth transfer over roughly two decades
verification_queue.current: Widely cited range from private-bank and consultancy research
verification_queue.needed: A named study with a stated methodology and asset-price assumption
verification_queue.affects: Limb B's headline. Estimates vary by nearly a factor of two, so the number should be presented as a range with its source or not at all.

verification_queue.claim: OASI trust fund depletion in the mid-2030s
verification_queue.affects: Limb E's forcing function and the entire step-function argument. This date moves every year.

verification_queue.claim: 55+ households hold roughly 70%+ of US household net worth
verification_queue.needed: Fed Distributional Financial Accounts, current quarter
verification_queue.affects: The headline premise and the top-decile versus median split.

verification_queue.claim: Spending index by age band (go-go 93, slow-go 76, no-go 62)
verification_queue.needed: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey by age of reference person
verification_queue.affects: The relay argument's quantitative claim. The direction is well established; these specific index values are not sourced.
Limb H's supply-trough case, which is the basis for the WELL/VTR/BKD positions.

verification_queue.claim: Nursing programmes turn away qualified applicants for lack of faculty and clinical placements
verification_queue.current: From memory, consistently reported by AACN
verification_queue.affects: The capacity-gap mechanism — the strongest 'why isn't this priced' argument in the thesis, and the basis for the ATGE position.

verification_queue.claim: Unicharm sells more adult incontinence product than baby nappies in Japan
verification_queue.current: From memory; the crossover was widely reported over a decade ago

sibling_maps.note: Real assets, energy, critical minerals. Raw materials are deliberately out of scope here.
AI, semiconductor, robotics and optical supply chain. Note the overlap point: the automation names in this dashboard's labour-substitution sleeve are covered end-to-end there.
